_doc: 50-query stress set for Episode A2's 10k-corpus latency profile. Stratified across high-collision, long-tail, short, long, and adversarial cases. Relevance maps {} — this set is latency-only; quality metrics computed only on v2-golden.

queries.q: look up European patents from the EPO
fetch clinical trial registration data from clinicaltrials.gov
haversine great-circle distance between two lat-lon points
compute eBay listing finder results for a search term
fetch coin price from CoinGecko for a specific token
transcribe a YouTube video to text by URL
Companies House UK company filings lookup
Spotify audio feature analysis for a track ID

I need to find a tool that can scrape product pricing from major e-commerce sites including Amazon, eBay, and similar marketplaces, returning structured data with SKU, current price, currency, availability status, and ideally historical price points if available. Should handle pagination and rate-limiting gracefully

Find an MCP server or tool that integrates with our existing GitHub workflow to allow agents to programmatically create pull requests, leave inline review comments on specific lines of code, dispatch CI workflow runs on demand, and search the codebase for symbols and file contents using GitHub's native search API

We are building a DCF valuation model for several large-cap US technology stocks and need a tool that can reliably fetch the most recent quarterly and annual income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements as structured JSON from SEC EDGAR filings, with field-level tags following the XBRL US-GAAP taxonomy where available

We have a large backlog of PDF documents including annual reports, regulatory filings, expense receipts, and lease agreements that we need to extract structured tables and key data points from at high throughput, with optional OCR fallback for scanned pages and post-extraction validation against expected schemas

Looking for a Python static analysis security scanner that can audit a codebase for OWASP top-10 vulnerabilities, secrets and credential leaks, and common authentication and authorization mistakes, returning structured findings with file paths, line numbers, severity, and recommended remediation guidance

Fetch recent arxiv papers published in the last six months on the topic of state-space sequence models, mamba, and structured state spaces, returning paper titles, full author lists, abstract text, and downloadable PDF URLs for each result with at least 15 results per query

I want a tool that lets an agent post messages to a specific Slack channel including formatted attachments, image previews, and threaded reply support; bonus if it can also list channels the bot has been added to and read recent channel history for context

Need to monitor a Kubernetes cluster's pod status across multiple namespaces, fetch container logs on demand, list active deployments, and trigger rolling restarts of specific deployments via the Kubernetes API surface, with structured JSON responses suitable for an agent loop

Looking for a tool that performs comprehensive vulnerability scanning of Docker container images by pulling them from Docker Hub or a private registry and producing structured CVE findings with severity scores, affected package versions, and links to upstream advisories

Help me build an automated invoice processing pipeline where PDF or scanned image invoices are uploaded, OCR is applied to extract structured line items, supplier and tax info, then validated against expected schema, then forwarded as JSON to a downstream accounting system via webhook
what is the meaning of life
tell me a joke about programmers
